title: Trường Sơn Auction: an online auction platform integrated with C06 and VNeID
summary: An online auction platform with a strict process, integrated with C06 and VNeID to verify participants.

blocks.text: Online auctions follow a regulated process, so participants need to understand each step and trust the transparency of the system.

items: Participants need to know which step they are on and what comes next.
Identity verification must be strict without making things hard for users.
Information about auction lots and bidding status must be clear and timely.

blocks.text: I led content and experience: turning the auction process and legal requirements into easy-to-follow steps, along with how status is communicated to users.

items: Registration, deposit, bidding, result, each step with a clear status.
Verification integrated with C06 and VNeID
Less manual entry and more trustworthy participants.
Starting price, time remaining and bid history are clearly displayed.

blocks.caption: Illustration: the auction lot screen and bid history

items: In a regulated product, explaining each step is part of the design.
Transparent status builds more trust than any reassurance.
